description: What the water is actually doing right now, not the forecast: the latest readings from NOAA buoys and coastal stations near a spot (National Data Buoy Center, within 60 miles): wave height in feet and how many seconds apart, wind and gusts in knots, water temperature, each with how many minutes ago. Use it when someone asks what it's like out there now, before a run offshore, or to check the forecast against reality. Give a position (offshore spots work), or a ramp name.

lat.description: Latitude of where the person is or will be

place.description: Or a Florida boat ramp name / place_id from boat_ramps

name: buoy_now
title: Buoy readings right now
